allow: Bash(npx eslint app/ lib/ components/ types/ --ext .ts,.tsx *)

hooks.statusMessage: Pre-delivery gate: npm run lint + npx tsc --noEmit
hooks.command: $l = npm run lint 2>&1 | Out-String; $lc = $LASTEXITCODE; $t = npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Out-String; $tc = $LASTEXITCODE; if ($lc -ne 0 -or $tc -ne 0) { $m = "Pre-delivery quality gate failed (CLAUDE.md). Fix these before finishing.`n`n=== npm run lint (exit $lc) ===`n$l`n=== npx tsc --noEmit (exit $tc) ===`n$t"; ConvertTo-Json -Compress -InputObject @{ decision = 'block'; reason = $m } }
